nusmp.page.book_fire.ultimate_fire: Ultimate Flame Magic: Crimson Sun Descent - A false sun of crimson fire is gathered above you and dropped on the whole field (original). Hold the page to cast: a long wind-up (about 6 to 10 seconds) holds you in place; you must be at FULL mana to start and ALL of it is taken at the release; a 16-block area hits up to 24 foes in three pulses and burns every foe for 12 seconds and slows, weakens and starves them. Taking a third of your health in damage, being sealed, dying, leaving or changing dimension breaks the cast (nothing is spent); sneaking lets it go. Opens only at the end of the mastery bar for a Senior 1st Class Magic Knight with 1,000,000 EP; cooldown 15 minutes.
